The '''HV6 Harvester Factory''' was a model of [[repulsorlift harvester]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. One unit, the ''[[Bountiful]]'', operated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ando/Legends|Ando]].<ref name="Ando" />
